Package index

Datasets

Observed and forecast records shipped with the package. See the “Model Input Datasets” article for sources, coverage and exploratory plots.

all_historical_forecasts
Historical weather forecasts and observed weather near Whychus Creek
all_rm_6_dates_and_times
historical RM 6 instream temperature - not summarized daily
all_rm_8_5_dates_and_times
Individual RM 8.5 logger readings, not summarised to daily statistics
camp_polk_flow_historical
Historical discharge at Camp Polk
camp_polk_temperature_historical
Historical instream water temperature at Camp Polk
dynamical_gfs_forecasts
Archived GFS air temperature and cloud cover forecasts near Whychus Creek
rm_6_historical
historical RM 6 instream temperature
rm_8_5_historical
Historical RM 8.5 instream temperature
sisters_air_temp_historical
Historical observed air temperature near Sisters, Oregon
sisters_precip_historical
Historical precipitation near Sisters, Oregon
whychus_at_sisters_historical
Historical instream water temperature and discharge at WHYCHUS CR AT SISTERS, OR
whychus_nr_sisters_historical
Historical instream water temperature and discharge at WHYCHUS CR NR SISTERS, OR

Functions

Data retrieval helpers, the RM 6 linear model, and utilities.

get_historical_forecast()
Retrieve historical forecast data at specific lead times
get_historical_forecast_range()
Pull historical forecasts across a long date range in annual chunks
get_historical_weather()
Retrieve historical observed weather data
get_nws_forecast()
Retrieve weather forecast data from the National Weather Service API
get_owrd_hydro()
Retrieve hydrological data from the Oregon Water Resources Department
`%||%`
Null coalescing operator
lm_rm6_7dadm()
Fit or apply a linear model predicting RM 6 7DADM from RM 8.5 7DADM
rm_6_predict()
Predict RM 6 7DADM from an RM 8.5 temperature value
to_julian()
Convert a date to Julian day of year
